newsitem.title: JAPAN: Miyakoshi stock transfer incomplete -- China firm.
newsitem.headline: Miyakoshi stock transfer incomplete -- China firm.

text.p: Qingdao Sifang Dianzi Shangcheng Shiye Gongsi, a Chinese electronics parts company which recently announced it held about 20 percent of Miyakoshi Corp's shares, said on Monday it had yet to transfer ownership of the shares.
"We bought 7.4 million of Miyakoshi's shares but we have not transferred ownership and we cannot comment on whether or not we will buy more shares," an executive told reporters in Tokyo.
In March, the firm said it aimed ultimately to acquire up to 19 million shares in Miyakoshi, an electrical equipment manufacturer.
The executive added that the purpose of his current visit to Japan was to look into a takeover of Miyakoshi and the possibility of a tie-up with a separate Japanese firm. He did not elaborate.
"We have been contacting Miyakoshi (about an acquisition) through a third party, but have so far not received a reply," the executive said.
Miyakoshi said it had not heard from the Chinese firm.
"Even if a business proposal were to emerge, at this point we have no plans to cooperate (with the Chinese firm)," a Miyakoshi spokesman said.
Miyakoshi shares on Monday rose three yen on the Tokyo bourse to end at 495 while falling 12 yen on the Osaka bourse to finish at 486.
